author: fallenazael
quote:
Dune is a good game , 95% of it is pve and is good. Ok combat is not the best, but exploration and building are good. 
What ruins the game is the complete lack of planning with the Deep Desert which is pvp. Its vast, empty and boring as hell.  Funcom have done everything to FORCE players to interact, moving resources to given locations to FORCE interaction between players, increasing the weight of those resources FORCING players to do multiple trips. You get the idea. 
A flawed concept that ruins everything.
And don't get me started on how clans camp and pick off people only trying to get resources , which makes the players lose EVERYTHING! Given that this game is gear orientated that ****

author: fallenazael
quote:
Boring. BORING. Buggy even for a bethesda game.  Too heavy in crafting (and I like crafting in a game), spending more time running around managing outposts than actually doing missions. The AI is hilariously buggy. Terminals and craft stations not working. Bugs, bugs, bugs.
This game feels like its trying to be too much without ever mastering any of them. The combat is ok (and that's the best you can say). The space combat is laughable. The ships horrendously ugly.  The characters are 1 dimensional, the plot so boring it'll have you tapping to fast forward the dialogue. I got this on game pass and Microsoft was robbed by Bethesda. It really is a c**p game.

author: fallenazael
quote:
Technically a mess ; frame rate drops, crashes when launching, crashes when loading, saves corrupt causing crashes (meaning you might have to start the game again). Utterly unacceptable for the price.
The game doesn't feel like a jedi game ; it offers more yet without feeling like being a jedi. I hate you have to wait until the end of the game to open or unlock pathways. Same for jedi powers which  you don't get (even though you had them in the previous game. ) Force powers down seem as powerful as they should.
Pointless running and jumping, sliding and wall running which we've all seen jedi do. Oh wait, no we haven't . Did the game designers even look at previous star wars sources before designing this bland world.
The main villians are 'meh' , pointless, toothless and instantly forgettable. Monsters don't seem like star wars creatures with the exception of the rancor and wompa tyle creature.
THIS GAME IS NOT FUN!!! Game's aren't meant to be fun any more, just as they are not meant to work on launch anymore. It doesn't feel like a star wars setting.  Aliens never seen before. Jedi with blasters, the great lightsaber **eye rolls** oh ffs.

author: fallenazael
quote:
Lacking vision and end game. Broken at launch.

Ultimately is a loot shooter so if another player catches you in PvP and has better gear than you , no matter how good you are , you're dead.

The division is an ok cover based shooter (although no player uses cover in PvP but ubisoft over looks that ) up until lvl 30 (the max) upon reaching this milestone the game changes from exploring and liberating to daily mission, dark zone and incursion grinds.
High end gear is extremely difficult and rare to find. Crafting is , to be honest, a joke as you can not craft nothing decent unless you spend 300,000 dark zone points and need to be lvl 75 in the dark zone. Multiplayer nerfs lover gear score players as group quickly kick any player with a low gear score which , in essence, means ubisoft is acutely rewarding players who have used the cheats and exploits to get the best gear.
The utter lack of thought that ubisoft has approached the end game with is shocking, and please remember this game was 4 years in the making!!! Every update they are tweaking and changing things. Upon launch named weapons were considered the best, after the update they are nothing short of a joke.
Save you money. DON'T BUY THE SEASON PASS!!! Get another game, hopefully something non ubisoft so they can't screw it  up!

author: fallenazael
quote:
Lazy, confused and unexplained storytelling lets down this shooter.  Each area's boss quests are disjointed and quickly become yawns players struggle through to get back to the carnage.
Nothing really  new in weapons from far cry 4.
All in all I was expecting more. Another disappointment to add to the growing list of disappointing , over hyped , unfinished games on release.
No wonder the DLC's have nothing to do with Far Cry 5, it tells you that the devs could not add more to this game.
